S1212.reason: Under English law, a custom must be recognised by Parliament (or be immemorial and legally established) before courts incorporate it into domestic law.

S0853.reason: By continuity, velocity scales inversely with area, so reducing area to 1/3 triples velocity to 6 m/s.

S0607.reason: Alienage classifications by a state are suspect and subject to strict scrutiny, so the candidate likely wins.
